definition_traps: Registered (tổng vốn đăng ký) = new projects' registered capital + adjusted (added) capital of existing projects + value of capital contributions/share purchases (góp vốn, mua cổ phần, GVMCP). GVMCP is M&A of existing firms; it is not a new plant and need not bring fresh FX (can be a buy-out from residents).
Disbursed (vốn thực hiện) = capital actually spent by FDI projects in the period, including funds raised domestically; it is an estimate, revised later.
BoP FDI (SBV, BPM6) ≠ disbursed: liabilities-side inflows only, excludes domestically funded spending; held series is ~80% of disbursed.

Ratio moves because registration is lumpy (one mega-project, e.g. a 4.9 bn port, moves a month's total) and front-loaded, while disbursement follows construction over 3-5 years; a registration surge lowers the ratio for 1-2 years, then disbursement catches up (2022's ratio 76.5% was a low-registration year).

Vintage: ECON_OFFICIAL.fdi_reg_musd 2010-2023 carry the revised vintage (e.g. 2023 39,390.3; 2022 29,288.2) while 2024-2025 are first releases; first releases were 36.61 bn (2023) and 27.72 bn (2022). Year-on-year rates published by FIA use the revised base (2024 'down 3%' vs 39.39).
YTD yoy rates compare with the same period's revised base, so 9M-2025 implied (28.55 bn) may differ from the 9M figure published a year ago.
Provincial totals (e.g. HCMC 17.2 bn to 19/9) use the province's own cut-off and include domestic-registered capital of FDI firms in some reports — never add them to the national figure.

open_conflicts.assessment: Vintage difference, not an error — but the array mixes revised (≤2023) and first-release (2024-25) values without saying so. Economy to label the vintage per year.

definition_traps: Kiều hối (SBV) = transfers received through credit institutions and licensed economic organisations (cash + bank channels counted by SBV). HCMC numbers say 'qua các tổ chức tín dụng và tổ chức kinh tế' — a channel-based, not a residency-based, measure.

BoP secondary income (credit) = all current transfers incl. workers' remittances, personal transfers, aid and other transfers; held secondary_income_in 2025 19.77 bn > 'over 16 bn' kiều hối. Compensation of employees sits in primary income, not here.
World Bank KNOMAD 'remittances' = personal transfers + compensation of employees (BPM6) — a third definition; held remit_in 2015-2023 is this series.
Labour-export remittances (MoHA/DOLAB 6-7 bn/yr) are a subset estimate, not additive to the total.
HCMC share 'about 60% of national' is a rule of thumb, not data — do not derive a national total from it.
HCMC was merged with Bình Dương and Bà Rịa-Vũng Tàu from 01/07/2025; check whether SBV Region 2's 2025-2026 figures and yoy bases cover the merged city (to verify).
